description: List tasks (project-management work items, distinct from test cases and defects) in the connected project — id/code, title, state, priority, assignee(s), and a linked defect id when raised against one. Give `search` for a title keyword, `storyId` for tasks tagged to a user story, `state`/`assignedTo`/`createdBy` to narrow further, or `filters: [{ column, value }]` for any other project-configured column with no dedicated parameter. Omit everything for the full project list. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Read-only and product-neutral. When presenting this as a table, label the columns "ID" and "Name" — the underlying fields are literally named `code`/`title`, but that's internal wire terminology, not what to show the user.

assignedTo.description: Numeric userId of the assignee. Pass "me" for the current caller. Resolve names via list_users first.

createdBy.description: Numeric userId of the creator. Pass "me" for the current caller. Resolve names via list_users first.

filters.description: Extra raw column filters for project-configured columns with no dedicated parameter above.

column.description: Backend field name to filter on, e.g. "priority", "moduleId", "customFields.Team".

regEx.description: Substring/regex match instead of exact equality.

value.description: Exact-match value (or substring when `regEx` is true).

search.description: Keyword to find tasks by title.

state.description: Exact workflow state key — from an existing row's `state` value, not the capitalized UI label.

storyId.description: Only tasks tagged to this user story (id or business key, e.g. US_123).

name: task_list
title: List / search tasks
